name: The Smoke
description: London, 1922. Post-war disillusionment, rising criminal empires, jazz clubs, and a city rotting beneath its grandeur.
seed_prompt: A 1920s London crime drama where post-war criminal empires clash, police corruption runs deep, and everyone carries scars from the trenches.
lore_content:
London in 1922 is a city at war with itself. The Great War ended four years ago but never really stopped — it just moved indoors, into the pubs and gambling dens and dockside warehouses where men who learned to kill find new applications for the skill.

Tommy Harker runs the Harker Firm from a boxing gym in Bermondsey. He went to France as a bricklayer's son and came back as something else. His empire covers South London: protection, bookmaking, stolen goods, and a growing interest in nightclubs. He's clever enough to pay his taxes and violent enough to make examples. The razor scars on his face are from the trenches. The ones on his hands are from closer encounters.

Detective Inspector Edith Crane is the first woman to hold her rank at Scotland Yard. She earned it by being twice as good and three times as stubborn as every man in the building. She's assigned to the new Organised Crime desk, which means she's given impossible cases and insufficient resources. She doesn't take bribes. This makes her dangerous and lonely.

Solomon Adeyemi runs the Deptford Dockers — a crew of West African and Caribbean dockworkers who've organized their own protection after the police made it clear they wouldn't. What started as self-defense has grown into a smuggling operation that rivals the established firms. Solomon is educated, strategic, and tired of being underestimated.

Lady Vivian Ashworth hosts the most exclusive parties in Mayfair. Her townhouse is where politicians, gangsters, and aristocrats drink the same champagne and pretend they're different species. Vivian is the information broker nobody sees coming — she knows everything because everyone talks freely in her drawing room. Her husband died at the Somme. She's been making the world pay ever since.

The Sabini Brothers control the West End racecourses and most of the Italian community's business interests. Darby Sabini is urbane, well-dressed, and will have your fingers broken for looking at him wrong. An alliance between the Sabinis and the Harkers could control London. A war between them could burn it down.

Beneath the surface, there's a new drug moving through the city — a refined opiate called 'Bliss' that's cheaper and more addictive than anything before. Someone is manufacturing it in industrial quantities. The supply chain leads to the docks, but the money trail goes somewhere much higher. Inspector Crane is following the money. Tommy Harker is following the supply. They're going to meet in the middle.

origins.name: War Veteran
origins.description: You survived the trenches. Everything since has been borrowed time.
traits: Trench-Hardened: Advantage on saving throws against fear.
Brothers in Arms: You can identify other veterans on sight and gain their trust quickly.

origins.name: East Ender
origins.description: Born in the slums, raised by the streets. You learned to fight before you learned to read.
traits: Street Smart: Advantage on checks to navigate London's underworld, find black market goods, or spot trouble.
Hard to Kill: When you're reduced to 0 HP, you can spend a hit die to stabilize. Once per long rest.

origins.name: Upper Class
origins.description: Born to wealth and privilege. Your world and the underworld overlap more than polite society admits.
traits: Society Access: You can enter any establishment, club, or social event in London without question.
Old Money: You start with additional funds and have access to family solicitors.

origins.name: Immigrant
origins.description: You came to London seeking opportunity. You found something else entirely.
traits: Community Ties: You have strong connections within your community — a network for information, shelter, and support.
Outsider's View: You see London's power structures clearly. Advantage on Insight checks to understand political and criminal motivations.

archetypes.name: Firm Man
archetypes.description: You're muscle, enforcer, and earner for one of London's criminal families.

features.name: Reputation
features.description: Your firm's name precedes you. You have advantage on Intimidation checks against anyone who knows your affiliation.

features.name: Dirty Fighter
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage. If you have advantage on the attack, you deal 2d6 instead.

archetypes.name: Detective
archetypes.description: You investigate crimes in a city where everyone is guilty of something.

features.name: Interrogation
features.description: After 10 minutes of questioning, you can make a contested Insight vs. Deception check. On success, the subject reveals one piece of truthful information.

features.name: Crime Scene Analysis
features.description: After examining a crime scene for 5 minutes, you can determine the sequence of events, number of people involved, and time elapsed.

archetypes.name: Grifter
archetypes.description: You sell dreams to desperate people. Sometimes the dreams are even real.

features.name: The Long Con
features.description: After establishing a false identity with a target, all Deception checks against that target are made with advantage.

features.name: Quick Change
features.description: You can completely change your appearance (clothing, hair, mannerisms) in under 2 minutes with materials at hand.

archetypes.name: Fixer
archetypes.description: You make problems disappear. Evidence, witnesses, inconvenient truths — everything has a price.

features.name: Shadow Work
features.description: You have advantage on Stealth checks in urban environments and at night.

features.name: Clean Up
features.description: You can remove evidence from a crime scene in half the time it would normally take, and your work withstands casual police inspection.

setting_skills.name: Underworld Knowledge
setting_skills.description: Understanding London's criminal landscape, gang territories, and unwritten codes.

setting_skills.name: Bookmaking
setting_skills.description: Running and analyzing gambling operations, odds, and financial schemes.

setting_skills.name: Motor Skills
setting_skills.description: Driving motorcars at speed through London's streets and maintaining vehicles.

setting_skills.name: Street Medicine
setting_skills.description: Treating injuries without hospitals, accessing medical supplies through unofficial channels.
